scope: Synthetic service scenarios plus compiled MCP/CLI journey. Service timings exclude process startup, providers and UI rendering; no LLM routing is evaluated.

criteria.intent: Read often and change priorities without waiting for a provider scan.
criteria.acceptance: Seven prepared reads and seven local writes preserve current revisions with one initial provider collection; report service timings without a machine-specific latency gate.

criteria.intent: Keep the chosen NOW when another client submits stale state.
criteria.acceptance: Exactly one NOW in Focus, stale write rejected, retry replayed without another revision.

criteria.intent: Review exactly the response I saw, with Undo.
criteria.acceptance: Opening leaves Ready intact; acknowledgement obtains fresh evidence; Undo restores; later responses reappear and old evidence is rejected.

criteria.intent: Finish, reopen and continue work in an exact successor chat.
criteria.acceptance: Finish clears NOW without auto-promotion, keeps pending review, Reopen leaves NOW unselected, exact continuation preserves predecessor history.

criteria.intent: Keep useful saved metadata without claiming stale provider activity.
criteria.acceptance: Disk cache is neutral with no live review or commands; account scopes cannot reuse it; priority store excludes titles; cache is owner-readable only.

criteria.intent: Use the native widget and Codex plugin interchangeably.
criteria.acceptance: The compiled native CLI and MCP tools see shared revisions, preserve concurrent winners, and agree on Finish/Reopen/continuation/history.
